caseNameFull: Roe v. Norton, Commissioner of Welfare

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. Conn. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 415 U. S. 912.] Motion of children of appellants for divided argument with appellants and for additional time for oral argument granted, and 10 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Appellee also allotted 10 additional minutes for oral argument.
